decisions.reason: This product is closely related to the firm's wafer-processing and materials capabilities, so under an absorptive-capacity view the firm is likely to learn from early market feedback and refine it rather than withdraw it quickly despite its higher technical complexity.

Carrier wafers for handling are highly aligned with the firm's existing substrate, packaging and customization know-how, making the product easy to support and improve and therefore unlikely to be taken off the market soon.
